g.text: As an Engine Developer I want to be able to make engine
changes without worrying about application interop
As an Engine Developer I want an easy way to spin up and
test changes made to the engine
As an Engine Developer, I want to be able to receive feedback,
so that I can use it to guide further development
As an Engine Developer I want to know the expected features
of a standard competition
As an Engine Developer I want to know what to work on and
have what's assigned to me easily findable
As an Engine Developer I want other's code changes to be well
documented and tested before viewing it
As a Competition Developer I want to have unchanging
and consistent APIs.
As a Competition Developer I want well defined
boundaries for engine and client behavior.
As a Competition Developer, I want to be able to see
metrics and logs to inform me of any potential issues,
so that I can act on them before the competition
starts.
As a Competition Developer, I want to be able to
develop the game logic in whatever language I am most
familiar with.
As a Competition Developer, I want to be able to create
multiple types of games, such as games where players
may be on a team together, or where players can only
take certain actions on certain turns.
As a Competition Developer, I want to be able to create
different tournament methods, such as round-robin &
elimination.
As a Competition Developer, I want to keep my
dependencies minimal, so that I can create the server
quickly.
As a Competition Developer, I don't want to have to
worry about how the client and game engine connect so
that I can focus on developing the game challenges.
Competition Developer
As a Competition Artist I want to make an upload art without
worrying about internal behavior of the engine
As a Competition Artist I want the uploading and linking of
assets to be my only interaction with the engine
Engine Developer
Competition Artist
Non-Users
Prior To Competition
As a Competition DBA I want to be able commit data changes while the
application is running.
As a Competition DBA, I want to store the teams that are competing.
As a Competition DBA, I want to store the games and points awarded to
the teams.
As a Competition DBA, I want to know which teams are competing in a
game.
As a competition DBA, I want to see the changes in the GameState
during a game so that it can be visualized.
As a competition DBA, I want to know what organization each team is
from.
As a competition DBA, I want to know the organizations competing in
this competition.
As a competition DBA, I want to know what category a team belongs to
so I can award different prize categories
As a Competition DBA, I want to be able to see the results of a specific
tournament.
During Competition
As a Competition Playtester I want to have debugging tools in the
visualizer
As a Competition Playtester I want an easy way to replay or quickly
iterate on existing competitions
As a competition competitor i want to write and test code for bots to
compete in the competition.
As a Competitor, I want to be able to submit a bot at anytime during
the competition.
As a Competitor, I want to be able to retrieve previous bots so that I
can recover my code if I fail to maintain version control
As a Competitor, I want to be able to select a previous submission as
my active submission, so that I don't have to submit a bot that has
the same functionality as an earlier one.
As a Competitor, I want to be able to log output and see it when
testing code, so that I can get information about potential crashes or
unintended behaviour.
As a Competitor, I want to know what the competition rules, tools, and
actions easily available to me so that I can develop my bot against
that information.
Competitor
As a Spectator I want an easy way to view games I want to see.
As a Spectator I want to be able to view previous games.
As a Spectator I want a stream
Spectator
As a Competition Supporter, I want to be able to see if anyone is having
issues without them reporting it so that I can respond to issues quicker.
As a Competition Supporter, I want a quick and easy method to patch and
redeploy different components without information loss.
Competition DBA
Competition Supporter
Competition Playtester
As a Competition DBA I want to make quick changes to data.
As a Competition DBA, I want to be able to query data throughout the
competition so I can report on information on the fly.
Competition DBA
